Samajwadi Party chief Akhilesh Yadav's planned December 12 visit to the Ram Temple in Ayodhya has triggered a political war of words with Uttar Pradesh Chief Minister Yogi Adityanath, who demanded an apology from him. Akhilesh hit back by raising questions over the alleged theft of temple donations.
